nodes.description: Private base token URI string of the ERC721Burnable collection, written in initialize and read by _baseURI.
EIP-2981 royalty receiver address stored by ERC2981Upgradeable.
EIP-2981 royalty share in basis points (1/10000) stored by ERC2981Upgradeable.
Owner address maintained by OwnableUpgradeable and consumed by the onlyOwner modifier.
ERC721 mapping of owner address to token balance, mutated on mint, burn and transfer.
ERC721 mapping of token ID to owner address, mutated on mint, burn and transfer.
Public initializer that sets name/symbol via __ERC721_init, stores the base URI, sets royalty info and mints the initial supply.
onlyOwner external function that mints a new token to the given address via _safeMint.
External batch executor that loops over calldata and delegate-calls each payload back to this contract.
Private helper performing a low-level delegatecall on a target and bubbling up the revert reason.
onlyOwner external setter that forwards to _setRoyaltyInfo to update royalty receiver and BPS.
Internal virtual function writing _royaltyReceiver and _royaltyBps.
External view EIP-2981 hook computing royaltyAmount as (salePrice * _royaltyBps) / 10000.
Internal ERC721 _mint: validates, calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook, updates _balances/_owners and emits Transfer.
Internal ERC721 _burn: clears approval, calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook, decrements balance and deletes the owner entry.
Internal ERC721 _transfer: validates ownership, calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook and updates approvals, balances and owners.
Private hook that performs an external onERC721Received call on contract recipients after a safe mint/transfer.
UUPS internal override restricted with onlyOwner to authorize proxy upgrades.
Internal ERC721 transfer hook invoked before every mint, burn and transfer.
Public view ERC165 override combining ERC721 and ERC2981 interface support.
msg.sender via _msgSender(), attacker controllable caller used for ownership and approval checks.
Low-level target.delegatecall(data) executed inside _multicallFunctionDelegateCall, executing arbitrary external code in this contract's storage context.
Inline assembly revert(add(32, reason), mload(reason)) used to bubble up raw returndata.
Collection name passed to initialize.
Collection symbol passed to initialize.
Base token URI passed to initialize and stored into _baseTokenURI.
Royalty receiver address passed to initialize.
Royalty share in BPS passed to initialize.
Number of tokens minted during initialization.
Recipient of the initially minted tokens.
Recipient address of safeMint.
Token ID argument of safeMint.
Array of encoded calldata payloads supplied by the caller of multicall.
New implementation address passed to _authorizeUpgrade.
Royalty receiver argument of setRoyaltyInfo.
Sale price argument of royaltyInfo used in the royalty arithmetic.
Loop counter of the initial supply mint loop in initialize.
Array of raw return values assembled by multicall.
Boolean success flag returned by the low-level delegatecall.
Raw bytes returned by the low-level delegatecall and bubbled to the caller.

edges.reason: baseTokenURI_ argument is written into the _baseTokenURI state variable.
name_ parameter is consumed by initialize and forwarded to __ERC721_init.
symbol_ parameter is consumed by initialize and forwarded to __ERC721_init.
initialSupply_ bounds the mint loop in initialize.
royaltyReceiver_ flows from initialize into _setRoyaltyInfo.
royaltyBps_ flows from initialize into _setRoyaltyInfo.
receiver_ argument flows from setRoyaltyInfo into _setRoyaltyInfo.
initialSupplyReceiver_ is the mint recipient during initialization.
Loop index i determines each minted token ID (i + 1).
to argument becomes the mint recipient in _safeMint/_mint.
tokenId argument becomes the minted token ID.
Caller supplied data array elements are executed by _multicallFunctionDelegateCall.
salePrice_ is multiplied by _royaltyBps and divided by 10000 inside royaltyInfo arithmetic.
_royaltyReceiver is read and returned by royaltyInfo.
_royaltyBps is read to compute the royalty amount in royaltyInfo.
_setRoyaltyInfo writes the new value of _royaltyReceiver.
_setRoyaltyInfo writes the new value of _royaltyBps.
Return value of _multicallFunctionDelegateCall is stored in results.
delegatecall success flag is assigned to local success.
delegatecall returndata is assigned to local returndata and returned to the caller.
newImplementation address reaches _authorizeUpgrade through upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall.
_owner state variable is compared against msg.sender by onlyOwner on _authorizeUpgrade.
safeMint is gated by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender with the stored owner.
setRoyaltyInfo is gated by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender with the stored owner.
_authorizeUpgrade is gated by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender with the stored owner.
_transfer authorization depends on _isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId) and onERC721Received forwards _msgSender.
_mint increments _balances[to] and therefore updates the balance mapping.
_mint assigns _owners[tokenId] = to.
_transfer decrements the sender balance and increments the recipient balance.
_transfer rewrites _owners[tokenId] to the new owner.
_burn decrements _balances[owner].
_burn deletes _owners[tokenId].
initialize calls _setRoyaltyInfo to configure royalties.
initialize loops and calls _safeMint (which calls _mint) for the initial supply.
safeMint calls _safeMint which reaches _mint.
multicall loops over data and invokes _multicallFunctionDelegateCall for each payload.
_multicallFunctionDelegateCall executes the low-level delegatecall operation.
Failure of the delegatecall is processed by the assembly revert in verifyCallResult.
_mint calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before updating state.
_transfer calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before updating balances and owners.
_burn calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before clearing state.
_mint performed through _safeMint invokes the recipient's onERC721Received, handing control to an external contract mid-mint.
_transfer performed through _safeTransfer invokes the recipient's onERC721Received, handing control to an external contract after state updates.
onlyOwner modifier on setRoyaltyInfo checks msg.sender against the owner before executing.
onlyOwner modifier on safeMint checks msg.sender against the owner before minting.
onlyOwner modifier on _authorizeUpgrade checks msg.sender before any upgrade is applied.

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is only meaningful as the initialize argument feeding __ERC721_init.
symbol_ is only meaningful as the initialize argument feeding __ERC721_init.
baseTokenURI_ is only used inside initialize to populate _baseTokenURI.
initialSupply_ only controls the initialization mint loop bound.
initialSupplyReceiver_ is only used as the mint recipient during initialization.
to is the exclusive recipient argument of safeMint.
tokenId is the exclusive token identifier argument of safeMint.
data elements are the delegatecall payload executed by _multicallFunctionDelegateCall.
newImplementation is the address validated by _authorizeUpgrade before an upgrade.
salePrice_ is only used inside the royaltyInfo arithmetic expression.
i is the loop counter of the mint loop inside initialize.
results is the return array assembled by multicall from the delegatecall outputs.
success is the delegatecall status consumed by verifyCallResult inside the helper.
returndata is the raw delegatecall output returned or reverted inside the helper.
